dataBits.description: Number of data bits per frame

stopBits.description: Number of stop bits per frame

responseTimeoutMs.description: Response timeout for read/write operations in milliseconds

defaultSendMode.description: Default send mode for frame encoding (hex = hex string, ascii = ASCII text, raw = raw bytes)

interFrameTimeoutMs.description: Inter-frame timeout in milliseconds for detecting frame boundaries on serial

connectionSummary: Raw serial message tunnel for private serial protocols and lab bring-up. Supports HEX/ASCII/raw send modes, timed auto-send, CRC-16/LRC calculation, and frame builder utilities.
connectionSteps: Choose the serial port from the live host resource list.
Select a common baud rate from the dropdown or keep the default value.
Configure data bits, stop bits, and parity as needed.
Choose the default send mode (hex, ascii, or raw).
After connection, send HEX bytes, ASCII strings, or raw data and wait for the response frame.
readBehavior: Read sends the request frame using the configured send mode and waits for the next serial response with a configurable timeout. Write forwards the encoded byte sequence unchanged. Supports CRC-16/Modbus and LRC appending for frame integrity.
